title: Larmor Frequency
description: Essential: Final answer for part (1) is ω₀ = γB₀.

title: Rotating Frame Frequency
description: Essential: Final answer for part (2) is Δ = γB₀ - ω or (ω₀ - ω).

title: Effective Field Expression
description: Important: For part (3), correctly constructs B_eff in the rotating frame with the given b(t), including the double-frequency oscillating terms.

title: Time-Averaged Field
description: Important: Correctly states that the time average of the oscillating terms is zero, leaving B_eff_avg = (B₀ - ω/γ)k'.

title: Rotating Wave Approximation
description: Important: For part (4), applies the approximation to drop the high-frequency (2ω) terms, yielding B_eff ≈ b i'.

title: Rabi Frequency
description: Essential: Final answer for part (4) is the precession frequency Ω = γb.

title: Spin Population Functions
description: Essential: Final answers for part (5) are P↑ = cos²(Ωt/2) and P↓ = sin²(Ωt/2).

title: Sign Error in b(t)
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong sign for the b(t) component in part (3), leading to incorrect phase in the rotating frame transformation.

title: Missing Gyromagnetic Ratio
description: Pitfall: Omits the factor of γ in the relationship between torque, angular momentum, and precession frequency.

title: Frame Confusion
description: Pitfall: Fails to distinguish between lab frame and rotating frame vectors (i, j, k vs. i', j', k') in expressions for B_eff.
